user.title: Connect to 3D Print Log
user.description: Create a dedicated API key named "Home Assistant" under Settings → API keys in 3D Print Log, then paste it here.

data_description.base_url: Leave this as the default unless you run your own 3D Print Log API.
data_description.api_key: The key is stored in Home Assistant and sent only to the API URL above.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate 3D Print Log
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected. Create a new key named "Home Assistant" under Settings → API keys in 3D Print Log, then paste it here. It must belong to the same account.

data_description.api_key: The new API key for the same 3D Print Log account.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure 3D Print Log
reconfigure.description: Change the API URL or the API key. The new values must belong to the same account. Create keys under Settings → API keys in 3D Print Log.

data_description.base_url: The address of the 3D Print Log API.
data_description.api_key: An API key for the same 3D Print Log account.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check that you copied the whole key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to 3D Print Log. Check the API URL and your network.
error.invalid_url: The API URL is not valid.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This 3D Print Log account is already configured for this API URL.
abort.wrong_account: That API key or URL belongs to a different account. Use one for the account you originally set up.

unsupported_schema.title: Update the 3D Print Log integration
unsupported_schema.description: The 3D Print Log API for {title} sends data in schema version {schema_version}, but this version of the integration reads only version {supported_version}. Update the integration (in HACS) to keep receiving updates. Until then, its entities show the last data received.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for changes, in seconds (15 to 300).

adjust_remaining.name: Adjust remaining
adjust_remaining.description: Adds to or removes from a spool's remaining amount. Returns the grams before and after.

entity_id.name: Slot sensor
entity_id.description: A slot filament or slot remaining sensor. The spool loaded in that slot is used.

spool_number.name: Spool number
spool_number.description: The spool's number in 3D Print Log.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: The amount to add (positive) or remove (negative). It can't be zero.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Grams, millimeters of filament length, or milliliters of resin volume.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: A note for the adjustment, up to 1000 characters.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The 3D Print Log account. Needed only when more than one is set up.

set_spool_active.name: Set spool active
set_spool_active.description: Marks a spool active or inactive.

entity_id.name: Slot sensor
entity_id.description: A slot filament or slot remaining sensor. The spool loaded in that slot is used.

spool_number.name: Spool number
spool_number.description: The spool's number in 3D Print Log.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The 3D Print Log account. Needed only when more than one is set up.

log_maintenance.name: Log maintenance
log_maintenance.description: Records a finished maintenance task for a printer. Returns the new record's ID.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: The printer the maintenance was done on.

category.name: Category
category.description: The kind of maintenance, up to 256 characters.

description.name: Description
description.description: What was done, up to 1000 characters.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it was done. Defaults to now.

maintenance_id.name: Maintenance ID
maintenance_id.description: Reserved for closing open tasks. Not supported yet.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The 3D Print Log account. Needed only when more than one is set up.

invalid_slot_entity.message: Choose a 3D Print Log slot filament or slot remaining sensor.

spool_choice.message: Give exactly one of a slot sensor, a spool ID or a spool number.

slot_empty.message: No spool is loaded in that slot.

spool_not_found.message: 3D Print Log has no such spool.

spool_untracked.message: That spool doesn't track its remaining amount, so it can't be adjusted.

amount_invalid.message: The amount must be a number other than zero.

api_too_old.message: This action needs a newer 3D Print Log API than the one this account uses.

api_unavailable.message: Could not reach 3D Print Log. Try again in a moment.

entry_not_found.message: That 3D Print Log account isn't set up.

entry_not_loaded.message: That 3D Print Log account isn't loaded right now.

no_entry.message: No 3D Print Log account is loaded.

config_entry_required.message: More than one 3D Print Log account is set up. Choose one with config_entry_id.

invalid_printer_device.message: Choose a 3D Print Log printer device.

device_entry_mismatch.message: That printer belongs to a different 3D Print Log account than config_entry_id.

api_auth.message: 3D Print Log rejected the API key. Reauthenticate the integration.
